name: You're My Penguin
source:
Help Jun, a described "chronic over-thinker" make decisions at his new school with friends, conflicts, and romance in this Shounen-ai, anime style, coming of age story!

Jun lives inside his head. He has a love of food, penguins, and a tendency towards indecision and anxiety. What will happen when a mysterious boy in his class takes a special interest in him? It's up to you in the interactive, visual novel, romance game.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448710/]Steam[/url]]
